notes.title: Paintball Is Almost Here!
notes.notes:
These are just some [i]teaser [/i]for next week where we will be releasing the second minigame for Grottonnia. This is a time based paintball shooting game where you must hit all the targets as quickly as possible. Your time is [i]tracked [/i]and the levels get progressively more [i]difficult[/i]!
